comparison.objective: Bend copper tube to 90 degrees while discovering and compensating for hidden springback.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a free bender, pull and release its lever, observe irreversible bend set, and iteratively correct for material springback.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a relaxed 87–93 degree bend, released grippers and no overbend, tipping or loss of the bender; it does not assess rail-jig mating or rolling-element retention.
comparison.reason: This tests inference and correction of a hidden one-way material response, not continuous support and containment during a linear-bearing transfer. Missing numeric candidate transfer tolerances do not affect the distinction.
